keyPoints: Samuhit aankdon (grouped data) ka madhyak: pratyaksh vidhi me Σ(fx)/Σf — har varg ka varg-chihn x uski baarambarta, phir yog.
Kalpit madhyak vidhi: a maan kar d = x - a se tez ganana — madhyak = a + Σ(fd)/Σf; a beech ka varg-chihn lo.
Pad-vichalan vidhi: u = (x-a)/h se aur tez — madhyak = a + h x Σ(fu)/Σf; h varg-aakaar hai.
Bahulak (mode) = l + h x (f1-f0)/(2f1-f0-f2) — sabse zyada baarambarta wale varg (bahulak varg) se nikalta hai.
Madhyika (median) = l + h x ((n/2 - cf)/f) — n/2 vaan prekshan wale varg (madhyika varg) se; cf pichhle vargon ki sanchayi baarambarta hai.
Teenon ka sambandh: 3 x madhyika = bahulak + 2 x madhyak — ek nikalne me doosre kaam aate hain.
Aam galti: bahulak ke sutra me f0, f1, f2 galat varg se lena — f1 bahulak varg ki, f0 usse pehle wale ki baarambarta hai.
subject: Maths
title: Samuhit Aankdon ka Madhyak
